instructions: Get nutritious, home-cooked meals ready in a cinch! Taste of Home 30-Minute Healthy Cooking gives you an abundance of fast-to-fix, good for you recipes the whole gang will rave over. Serve up heartwarming meals you can feel great about in just 30 minutes or less! Your family will never know they're eating healthier with savory dinner recipes like Country Chicken with Gravy and Hearty Beef Ravioli. You'll love knowing you can whip up something wholesome for every meal and every occasion, from activity-packed weeknights to festive celebrations. You can even reward your family with delightful desserts like Chocolate Mousse with Strawberries and Maple Baked Apples to add a bit of sweetness into their day. You'll never be "too busy" to eat right again! Hardcover, 256 pages. Inside Taste of Home 30-Minute Healthy Cooking you'll find: *** 350+ lightened-up recipes and tips for healthy meals the whole family will love *** Quick and easy dinner recipes, flavor-packed party recipes, scrumptious desserts, and more
